newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL key share index ends up as Tenaga rebounds.
newsitem.headline: KL key share index ends up as Tenaga rebounds.

text.p: A rebound in heavyweight Tenaga Nasional stock helped push the key share market index higher at the close, but interest was mainly on secondary stocks, dealers said.
The Composite Index closed at 1,179.60, up 1.67 points, after hitting an intraday low of 1,173.24.
Apart from Tenaga, blue chips were generally neglected and ended flat.
"Tenaga provided some excitement in a market dominated by second board stocks," said one institutional dealer. "Blue chips were looking a bit tired."
The Second Board index rose 6.09 points to 643.48.
Trading was restricted ahead of a long holiday weekend. The market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
Market volume was 276 million shares, and gainers led losers 298 to 224.
Dealers said they expect the market to trade within a narrow band next week.
"I would expect to still see a fairly flat market," said Tony Shue, a vice president in institutional sales at Jupiter Securities. "I would assume there will be selective buying but in a small way."
